disabledApplicationPrincipal.errorBranchBasis: The production server resolves the unique binding first and deterministically returns HTTP 403 APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL_DISABLED when binding.state is not ACTIVE. During the observed request only the controlled application_identity_binding state was DISABLED; the participant and membership remained ACTIVE.

notes: No live funds or Paystack live-mode activation occurred.
The governed Google member identity produced HTTP 200 on /api/member-orders before the controlled binding mutation and HTTP 403 while the same binding alone was DISABLED.
The controlled binding was restored to ACTIVE immediately after the denial proof; participant and membership are ACTIVE and the authority grant remains unrevoked.

The exact APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL_DISABLED error branch is established by the production server implementation and the exclusive binding-state mutation; the browser-held bearer credential was never exposed or persisted into evidence.

The final bounded Production canary redeployed the immutable candidate with PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ACCESS_ENABLED=false. The canonical Production alias then returned HTTP 503 PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ACCESS_DISABLED on /api/member-orders.
The obsolete residual binding workflow was converted to explicit workflow_dispatch with an explicit target URL and retained credential guard; it no longer auto-runs on branch pushes.
